output_variables.core_mechanism: Self-cleaning bead-keyed in-code expiry markers hard-enforced in just check, generalizing the existing pyvision --epic-symbol loop
output_variables.recommendation: Layered lifecycle system: one structured BACKCOMPAT[bead-id] in-code marker per shim (source of truth), enforced by a bead-aware _lint-backcompat stage in just check (modeled on pyvision --epic-symbol), removal due only when both a calendar date and a release threshold pass, a removal bead created with the shim and workable via sase bead work, plus a scheduled sweep agent and generated deprecation timeline; one-time baseline reset deletes the existing dead shims now.
